meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via the selected gateway. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Codex 接入为编码代理,可与 Claude 并存或互相替换
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 Codex 和 Claude 同时当编码代理,并能按分组自由切换。
copy.tagline_en: Plug Codex in as a coding agent you can run beside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Codex and Claude as interchangeable coding agents per group.

howto.what: 把 Codex 装成群组的代理后端，该群组的规划、工具编排与会话续接由 Codex 负责；凭据只存在 OneCLI 保险库，容器里读不到密钥。
howto.when: 执行本技能的安装与授权步骤时；或由运维在主机上运行 ncl groups config update --provider codex 把某个群组切换过去时。

say.text: 帮我把 Codex 装成代理后端并完成授权。
把我这个群组的 provider 切成 codex 并重启。
say.note: 在主机上执行，需要群组 id。

say.text: 把新建群组的默认 provider 设成 codex。
say.note: 只影响之后新建的群组，需重启主机生效。

howto.what_en: Installs Codex (OpenAI codex app-server) as a group's agent backend: it handles planning, tool orchestration and session resume. Credentials stay in the OneCLI vault, so no key is readable in the container.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run this skill's install and auth steps, or when an operator switches a group on the host with `ncl groups config update --provider codex`.

say_en.text: Install Codex as the agent provider and finish auth.
say_en.note: Copies payload, wires barrels, rebuilds, then auths.

say_en.text: Switch my group's provider to codex and restart it.
say_en.note: Run from the host; needs a group id.
Affects only later groups; restart the host.
